rounds.question: Name a US foreign policy strategy during the Cold War

answers.explanation: This is a Cold War foreign policy strategy — Kennan's containment doctrine held that the US should prevent Soviet expansion without directly attacking the USSR.

answers.text: Truman Doctrine — aid to threatened nations
answers.explanation: This is a Cold War foreign policy strategy — Truman's 1947 speech pledged US support to Greece and Turkey and set a global precedent.

answers.text: Marshall Plan — economic aid to Europe
answers.explanation: This is a Cold War foreign policy strategy — $13 billion rebuilt Western Europe, preventing economic desperation that communists could exploit.
This is a Cold War foreign policy strategy — the North Atlantic Treaty committed the US and Western Europe to collective defense.
This is a Cold War foreign policy strategy — Eisenhower and Dulles threatened massive nuclear retaliation to deter Soviet aggression.

rounds.question: Name a Cold War conflict or confrontation

answers.explanation: This is a Cold War conflict — the US-led UN force fought to push communist North Korea back across the 38th parallel.
This is a Cold War conflict — the 1962 standoff over Soviet missiles in Cuba brought the US and USSR closest to nuclear war.
This is a Cold War conflict — the US fought to prevent communist North Vietnam from unifying the country under Ho Chi Minh.
This is a Cold War conflict — the airlift (1948) supplied West Berlin during a Soviet blockade; the Wall (1961) divided the city for 28 years.
This is a Cold War conflict — competition over satellites and the moon was a proxy for superpower technological supremacy.

rounds.question: Name a way the Cold War affected life inside the United States

answers.text: McCarthyism and the Second Red Scare
answers.explanation: This is a Cold War domestic effect — Senator McCarthy's accusations of communist infiltration ruined careers with little evidence.
This is a Cold War domestic effect — the House Un-American Activities Committee pressured Hollywood and government workers to name names.
This is a Cold War domestic effect — 'Duck and cover' drills and backyard shelters reflected genuine fear of nuclear annihilation.

answers.text: Loyalty oaths required for government jobs
answers.explanation: This is a Cold War domestic effect — federal employees were required to swear they had never been communists.
This is a Cold War domestic effect — the Red Scare paralleled WWI repression in silencing dissent through fear.

rounds.question: Name a reason the United States got involved in the Korean War

answers.explanation: This is a reason the US fought in Korea — directly applying the Truman Doctrine to a hot conflict on the Korean peninsula.
This is a reason the US fought in Korea — the Soviet boycott of the Security Council allowed a UN resolution authorizing force.
This is a reason the US fought in Korea — the June 1950 invasion across the 38th parallel triggered immediate US response.

answers.text: Truman Doctrine committed US to resist
answers.explanation: This is a reason the US fought in Korea — Truman felt bound by his own pledge to support nations resisting communist takeover.

answers.text: China and USSR backed North Korea
answers.explanation: This is a reason the US fought in Korea — Chinese intervention after UN forces approached the Yalu River widened the conflict dramatically.

rounds.question: Name something that contributed to the end of the Cold War

answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Cold War's end — 70 years of central planning and military spending left the USSR unable to compete.
This is a cause of the Cold War's end — the SDI program and defense spending forced the Soviets into an arms race they couldn't afford.
This is a cause of the Cold War's end — Gorbachev's openness and restructuring policies inadvertently destabilized Soviet control.

answers.text: Fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989
answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Cold War's end — the Wall's fall symbolized the collapse of communist control across Eastern Europe.

answers.text: Breakup of the Soviet Union in 1991
answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Cold War's end — 15 Soviet republics declared independence, formally ending the USSR on December 25, 1991.

rounds.question: Name a criticism of US involvement in the Vietnam War

answers.explanation: This is a criticism of Vietnam — napalm, Agent Orange, and operations like My Lai turned domestic and international opinion against the war.
This is a criticism of Vietnam — critics argued the US could win every battle but not the war without a political solution.
This is a criticism of Vietnam — student protests, veterans' demonstrations, and the 1968 Democratic Convention showed deep public opposition.
This is a criticism of Vietnam — Congress later learned the second Tonkin incident was fabricated, yet it gave LBJ blank-check war authority.
This is a criticism of Vietnam — college deferments meant the burden fell disproportionately on poor and working-class men.
